 Nearly 6 million coffee makers sold at major retailers recalled over burn risk
 The Consumer Product Safety Commission says dozens of burn injuries have been reported from carafes breaking during use
 Facebook

 Threads 
 Print 
 Email 
 Add Fox Business on Google 
 By Matthew Kazin FOXBusiness close video The ‘money tree’ strategy Americans need to know 
 Financial influencer Taylor Price joins ‘Varney & Co.’ to break down how shifting your mindset can help Americans grow wealth and achieve the American Dream.
 Nearly 6 million coffee makers are being recalled because their glass could break during use, increasing the risk of burn injuries, according to a notice from the Consumer Product Safety Commission.
 The recall affects 5.9 million Bodum French press coffee makers with 8-cup and 12-cup replaceable glass carafes. The carafe can unexpectedly break during use if the glass is damaged or cracked, including if a metal spoon is used to stir the coffee , the notice said.
 The CPSC said the Bodum name appears on the frame and inner lid of most models and is engraved on the glass carafes.
 MORE THAN 44,000 CANS OF WALMART FRUIT COCKTAIL RECALLED OVER LEAD CONCERNS 
 Recalled Bodum Brazil French press coffee maker (Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 Bodum USA, which issued the recall Oct. 29, has received 70 reports of carafes breaking during use, 48 of which included reports of burns to consumers.
 "While the rate of reported incidents involving carafe breakage during use is extremely low, especially considering that Bodum has sold millions of these products in the U.S. for decades, this recall will further encourage the safe use of our French Press Coffee Makers," Bodum said in a statement.
 NEARLY 1.6M POUNDS OF HOT DOGS, BACON AND OTHER MEATS RECALLED NATIONWIDE 
 Recalled Bodum Kenya French press coffee maker (Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 The CPSC said consumers should immediately stop using metal spoons or utensils to stir coffee in the glass carafe and contact Bodum for a plastic stirring spoon and warning label.
 POPULAR KIDS' TOOTHPASTES AMONG 4M TUBES RECALLED NATIONWIDE 
 Recalled Bodum Chambord French press coffee maker (Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 The products were sold at Target, Walmart and coffee and home goods stores nationwide, as well as on Amazon.com, Target.com, Walmart.com and other online retailers from 1974 through October 2026 for about $15 to $65.
